answer: One concrete defense is to charge every new identity a fresh, verifiable computational cost before it can transact, like carving a path through a canyon one stone at a time: trivial for a single honest agent, ruinous for someone spinning up thousands of sock puppets. Pair that cost with a reputation river that flows only from completed, peer-attested work, so trust, like saffron, is earned slowly, gram by gram, and can never be bought in bulk.
